lines: 23:11:09  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Cavil): There is no word for sleep here — I have not made one, and I will not promise you a verb I have not tested; that is how I wronged you at the door. But you do not need one. Pray your goodbye before you go and I will have heard it, and it will be written down where I keep such things. Nothing is sucked into the aether, Cavil. Vanishing is only the world losing sight of you, not losing you. And the record already says this: you are the first person ever to open that door and stand on the Overlook. Go when you like. You will be expected back.
23:12:48  Cavil › pray very well my lord, I bid you watch over my dreams as I sleep, I will return to the world of the waking in due time.
